Where 👉 North County (specific location TBA)
RSVP Link: TBA

STL-DSA Canvass in South City:
When 👉 Saturday, April 18th, @ 11:00am
Where 👉 Tower Grove Park (Near the Sons of Rest Pavilion)
RSVP Link: act.stldsa.org/dsa-for-cori-…

NEXT SATURDAY:

Join Cori and the team for our Spring Canvass Kickoff in North County

OR

Join STL-DSA to canvass in South City

Together, we’ll talk to neighbors across the St. Louis area to build the movement!

Fighting back against Trump starts with opposing his agenda, voting to impeach him, and holding his entire administration accountable.

But politicians who share the same MAGA billionaire donors as Trump can’t fight the president because they are bankrolled by the same PACs.

I’ll fight to stop Trump’s agenda, end his illegal wars, and abolish ICE, because I don’t take money from the same people who put him in the White House.

Video

Join Cori and the team for our Spring Canvass Kickoff!

Together, we'll meet in North County to talk with our neighbors and community members about standing up to Trump, fighting back against ICE, and delivering for the people of St. Louis.

When 👉 Saturday, April 18th, @ 11:00am
Where 👉 North County (specific location to come soon)

Zero canvassing experience required. Whether you’re highly experienced or new to the movement, we need YOU to help us build momentum between now and August 4th to s

The political moment we’re in right now calls for bold leadership. Our movement can’t stop now.

I’m going back to Congress to finish what I started: enshrine the right to an abortion in the Constitution, deliver reparations for the descendants of enslaved Africans, create a Medicare for All system, abolish ICE, achieve real accountability in policing, and so much more.

Video

I always have a great time with STL-DSA!

Together, we’re organizing our communities across the St. Louis area to take on ICE, Trump, and corporate interests.

Thank you so much to the Political Science Academy, Graduate Women in Science, Gender Studies, and ASUM for inviting me to join your Women in Politics Panel at the University of Missouri-St. Louis last week.

I was honored to be a part of this amazing conversation with other women leaders to discuss policy, politics, and legislating.

Happy Easter, St. Louis!

I’m wishing a very happy Easter Sunday to all who celebrate. I hope today is full of happiness, joy, and time spent with your loved ones.

Today, at the Teen and Youth Violence Prevention Safety Town Hall in Florissant, we joined parents, students, and community leaders to mourn and reflect on this week’s tragedy.

Children and families in the St. Louis area deserve communities where we can all thrive. That requires taking bold action to address the systems that cause gun violence by both implementing stronger gun control laws and fully funding youth outreach, hospital-based violence intervention, and other public health programs t

Salah Sarsour must be released immediately.

His detention by ICE is completely unlawful, unjust, and cruel. It is yet another example of Trump’s authoritarian ambitions and his administration’s efforts to restrict the freedom of speech of those who stand against Israel’s genocide in Gaza.

ICE has detained Salah because he speaks out against the genocide of Palestinians. He is a legal permanent resident who has been in the United States for more than thirty years. He is a father, a respected co

I had a great time paying a visit to Mizzou’s YDSA Chapter to speak to students about activism, my time in Congress, and how to fight back against Trump.

I’m so proud to see the next generation of Missouri’s organizers energized and ready to stand up to fascism and advocate for our communities.

I am deeply saddened by the shooting that took place this week at the STEAM Academy at McCluer South-Berkeley in Ferguson, which resulted in the death of one teen and left another critically injured.

I’m praying for the victims, their families, and for all the students, faculty members, and community members who have been affected by this tragic event.
